description: Common checks: merge conflict markers, large files, trailing whitespace, no direct commits on protected branches

max_kb.description: Largest file allowed in a commit, in KB

protected.description: Branches that don't accept direct commits, separated by |

hooks.name: large files
hooks.cmd: status=0; for f in {files}; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; kb=$(( $(wc -c < "$f") / 1024 )); if [ "$kb" -gt {{max_kb}} ]; then echo "$f: ${kb} KB (max {{max_kb}} KB)"; status=1; fi; done; exit $status

hooks.name: protected branch
hooks.cmd: branch=$(git branch --show-current); if echo "$branch" | grep -qxE '{{protected}}'; then echo "Direct commits on $branch are not allowed, use a branch"; exit 1; fi
